Hi Amit / Chelsey —

Thanks again for taking time to walk through the integration with Crestview earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on the security path forward.

Call summary (high level)
- You want to run private LLM-powered triage workflows against patient-entered symptoms; low-volume but moderate sensitivity.
- Key questions: SOC 2 posture, HIPAA support, where data is stored / residency, and whether we should complete a SIG (full), CAIQ, or a short custom form.

Redwood status (short)
- SOC 2 Type II: in progress; control testing started Q1 2027, expected report Q4 2027. We can provide SOC/attestation timeline and current gap list.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA customers via Business Associate Agreement and Private deployment options; we do not advertise PHI retention by default.
- Hosting: our hosted environment is us-east by default; Dedicated/Private deployments available for customers requiring isolation.

Clarifying asks from our side
1) Preferred questionnaire: do you want Crestview to receive a SIG (full) prefill from us, a CAIQ, or your custom vendor security questionnaire? If custom, please attach the current form so we can scope evidence.
2) Data flow: we need a short data-flow sketch indicating whether Crestview will send raw patient identifiers to the API or whether you’ll pseudonymize/strip PII client-side. That will change evidence and hosting recommendations.
3) Timeline: do you have a procurement / onboarding deadline (target date) that we should align to?

Proposed immediate next steps
- If you want SIG/CAIQ: we can prefill and return within 7 business days for SIG-lite or 10–12 for a full SIG bundle (evidence links).
- If custom form: please send the questionnaire and an example dataset schema.
- Karthik will follow up with a short SOC/controls timeline and a list of evidence owners (I’ve CC’d him).

Attachments: redwood-sig-vs-caiq-onepager.pdf (short pros/cons), network-diagram-stub.pdf (example redwood-hosting footprint)

Thanks — please let us know which form you prefer and whether you can share a simple data-flow sketch by Wednesday.

Best,

Amit — thanks for the quick follow-up and for the attachments. Answers inline below to help you decide which path: 

Q: Does Redwood cache prompts/responses by default?
A: Hosted API: we maintain short-term KV/prefix caches to optimize latency; caching is configurable and can be disabled for privacy-sensitive workloads. For Private/Dedicated deployments, caching is fully controllable by the customer.

Q: Can KV/prefix caching be disabled for private deploy?
A: Yes — for Private we can disable persistent KV caches and ensure only ephemeral in-memory buffers are used. That will also be noted in any SIG prefill evidence.

Q: Encryption/keys expectations
A: - Hosted: we use cloud KMS; we support customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest in hosted + Dedicated tiers.
- Private: you can bring your own KMS/HSM and have full key control.

Suggested next step for speed: send us the first two pages of your custom questionnaire (you already did) and say whether you want a SIG prefill or a direct custom answer set. If you choose SIG prefill we’ll complete the standardized fields and attach evidence pointers; if you choose custom we’ll map our evidence to your sections and call out any gaps.

Tentative timeline based on what you shared:
- SIG-lite prefill + evidence links: 7 business days after we get confirmation and the data-flow sketch.
- Custom form mapping: 10 business days (depends on number of custom questions).

I’ve copied two attachments to the drive link: redwood-sig-vs-caiq-onepager.pdf and a short evidence checklist (we’ll add the SOC timeline once Karthik provides it).

Would you be able to confirm form preference and share that simple data-flow sketch by EOD Wednesday (04/07)?

Thanks — Olga
